130000101.text: Traveler, you've come at a good time.

130000102.text: Wait, this sounds like... another commission?

130000103.text: Hehe, it is as you say. The commission this time around is of high importance. It pertains to the safety of the Avidya Forest's inhabitants.

130000105.text: Not long ago, we received word that a section of the Avidya Forest seems to have become "contaminated."

130000106.text: Contaminated? You mean... a new Withering Zone?

130000107.text: I don't know about the specifics, but I hear that strange things are happening to people who cross through that region.

130000108.text: The Avidya Forest's inhabitants won't leave their home so easily. If we allow this contaminated region to expand, the consequences could be unimaginable.

130000109.text: That's why I want to ask you to investigate the situation. Even if all you can do is stop the contamination from spreading, that will still save many people.

130000110.text: This is forest business... Hmm, maybe Tighnari will know something. Let's go find him!

130000201.text: This is where you've been, Tighnari! Hm? That's—

130000204.text: Am I going to die? *sniff* Tell Mom that I should've listened to her...

130000205.text: And tell Suna that I'm sorry for breaking her toy. I didn't tell her because I was scared that she wouldn't play with me anymore...

130000206.text: Tighnari, I heard that people turn into birds after they die. Is that true? I feel like I'm getting lighter...

130000209.text: You just have a small fever. Take your medication and rest. You'll be bouncing off the walls in no time.

130000210.text: Really? Then... Can you keep the thing about the toy a secret for now?

130000211.text: No can do. You're a big kid now. Once you've recovered, go and apologize. Keeping secrets to yourself won't solve anything.

130000213.text: Hey, let me ask you something... I recall that you're usually pretty healthy. How did you get this sick all of a sudden?

130000214.text: I don't know, either... Mom's been telling me not to play in the forest. I just wanted to look inside...

130000215.text: It's different from before... I got lost and went around in a huge circle.

130000216.text: After I got out, I started feeling dizzy...

130000220.text: So that's how this whole mess happened. Anyway, go rest. No running around until I say so, got it?

130000221.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, let's step out for now.

130000222.text: You leave the room with Tighnari...

130000223.text: Mr. Forest Watcher, how is my son?

130000224.text: I gave him some antipyretics. Let him rest here for a while.

130000225.text: I told him that he would feel better after some medicine and rest, but I only said that to comfort him.

130000226.text: His symptoms resemble a fever, but something else is causing them. They seem more akin to a disruption in his psyche. Antipyretics won't be of much use.

130000227.text: What do we do? Mr. Forest Watcher, you have to help him!

130000228.text: If memory serves, a plant called Vasanti Grass can help soothe the mind.

130000229.text: A small number grow in arid deserts. They usually look like shriveled weeds, but can be revitalized with a splash of water.

130000230.text: They're expensive and unable to grow in the Avidya Forest's climate, so I don't have any on hand.

130000231.text: I'll ask the caravans. Go find Collei, have her prepare medicinal tools, and a set of traveling gear for me.

130000233.text: Contaminated region, huh... Is that why you two are also here?

130000234.text: Yep. Is it a new Withering Zone?

130000235.text: Doesn't seem like one. Whether you look at scale, internal conditions, or resultant effects, they're completely different.

130000236.text: The only thing they have in common is that they aren't welcome. This nuisance made itself home in the Avidya Forest, so I can't turn a blind eye.

130000238.text: Alright, let's contact the caravans first and purchase some Vasanti Grass. We can also ask about the contaminated region.

130000239.text: There's no time to waste. We have to move quickly. Let's go.

subQuests.subQuestName: Buy Vasanti Grass from a traveling merchant

130000401.text: Excuse me, I'd like to purchase some Vasanti Grass. Do you have any?

130000402.text: I'm sorry, Mr. Forest Watcher, but we've been closed for the past few days.

130000403.text: Closed? Now that's odd. It's my first time hearing you say something like that.

130000404.text: *sigh* It's a long story... Some of our goods were stolen recently.

130000405.text: They were mechanical parts that we got from the Akademiya. Although they're old models, they still fetch a good price on the market.

130000406.text: Our caravans had to pool together Mora to afford those parts. Now that they've been lost, we'll likely come up short this trip.

130000407.text: All the merchants talked it over, and we decided to raise the prices of our remaining inventory. Until this plan takes effect, none of us can privately sell anything.

130000408.text: I don't get it. If these goods are so important, then why not think of a way to get them back?

130000409.text: Raising prices won't solve anything. At best, you're shoving the consequences of the robbery onto your customers.

130000410.text: Mr. Forest Watcher, it's not that we don't want to, it's just the thief disappeared into the deepest parts of the forest.

130000411.text: We asked around, and apparently the forest has been very unusual as of late. Anyone who goes in experiences mental anomalies.

130000412.text: We can't keep waiting out here for the thief to come out. All we could do is come up with another solution.

130000413.text: So the bandit hid in the contaminated region after stealing those mechanical parts?

130000414.text: How many people were there in total? Were they not affected by the contaminated region?

130000415.text: That crook CAME from the contaminated region! As for how many... Err... There weren't any "people."

130000417.text: *sigh* Even if I tell you, you might not believe me. *sigh* Fine, the thief that stole our parts was a huge, mechanical crab!

130000418.text: What the heck!? The Avidya Forest has creatures like that?

130000421.text: To be honest, I'd rather not think about it... It moved too skillfully to be new at this.

130000422.text: It came out of nowhere. Before we could react, it swiped our goods and ran away.

130000423.text: We were all shocked. By the time we came to our senses, the thief was already long gone.

130000424.text: I see. If we help you retrieve your stolen goods, then business will return to normal?

130000426.text: Not only that, but you'll become one of our caravan's VIPs. On all future purchases of any—

130000427.text: Enough. Tell me something that's actually useful. Any leads on that mechanical crab?

130000428.text: Maybe one? After our goods were stolen, we specifically got someone to assess the situation.

130000429.text: If you're interested, you can go and talk to them.

130000430.text: Alright, we'll go and have a word.

130000501.text: After the goods were stolen, I made multiple inquiries with nearby caravans and residents.

130000502.text: Turns out that many others have also been robbed by that crooked crab.

130000503.text: However, the crab only seems to be interested in machinery. It doesn't even bat an eye at other valuables.

130000504.text: A caravan carrying a large amount of Mora had an uneventful trip, but another caravan had a child whose metal toy was taken.

130000505.text: Whatever the case, that thing is a scourge! We'll eventually think of a way to get rid of it!

130000601.text: That mechanical crab is fast, strong, and a pain to deal with.

130000602.text: Ten of us might not even be able to take that thing head-on.

130000603.text: Didn't the Akademiya ban research on mechanical life forms years ago? Where did that thing come from?

130000604.text: Our salaries even got slashed because of it... *sigh* Who would've thought that the robber wasn't a human, but a mechanical crab? This is rough...

130000701.text: I heard from the caravaners that there have been a lot of robberies lately, but we haven't been affected.

130000702.text: We don't normally see the mechanical crab, and it doesn't disturb our daily lives.

130000703.text: It only shows up when the caravans are here, and it runs back to the contaminated region after it's done making a mess.

130000705.text: We have, but it's too agile and fast.

130000706.text: However, we did unexpectedly learn something the last time we tried to capture it.

130000707.text: It apparently lives in the deepest part of the forest, so instead of immediately moving its spoils, it first hides them nearby.

130000708.text: Once its stash grows large enough, it moves everything in one go. You'll have to move fast if you want those goods back.

subQuests.subQuestName: Discuss what to do with the traveling merchant

130000901.text: How are things? Did you make any progress?

130000902.text: We learned of its behaviors, but much still remains unclear.

130000903.text: Assuming normal operational status, mechanical constructs generally act according to their given commands.

130000904.text: If I were its owner, I'd command it to steal more valuable things... or the Mora you made. That would be the most efficient method.

130000905.text: But it only goes after mechanical components. This doesn't make any sense.

130000907.text: So you all found a way to retrieve our goods?

130000908.text: Do you have any more mechanical parts with you?

130000909.text: Yes, I still have a small bag of samples. They weren't taken since I keep them on me at all times.

130000911.text: Under constant external conditions, organisms rarely initiate changes in their habits.

130000912.text: Here's what we know so far: It has a mechanical composition; it lives in the contaminated region; and it comes out to steal mechanical components.

130000913.text: If we have said components, we can lure it out, capture it, and then make observations for further conclusions.

130000914.text: Well... Chatting like this won't get us anywhere. We're only wasting time.

130000915.text: You're right. We don't have any other options right now... This bag of samples is all yours, Mr. Forest Watcher. If you can get our goods back, the caravans will reward you generously.

130000916.text: We don't need anything in return, but I'll be keeping this bag. I may have other uses for it later.

130000917.text: We'll also need to borrow a Sumpter Beast. Our act has to be convincing if we want the crab to fall for it.

130000918.text: Oh yeah, no problem at all! If it means getting our things back, you can even borrow me to do whatever you need!

130000919.text: I'll have to decline that offer. Anyway, we'll use the mechanical components and Sumpter Beast to pose as a transiting caravan and lure out the crab.

130000920.text: Once it appears, capture it. I leave the timing to you.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the location where the robbery took place

130001001.text: Looking at the trade routes and the contaminated region's current perimeter, the goods were likely stolen somewhere around here.

130001002.text: Then let's get to it! We'll definitely capture that criminal crab!

130001003.text: Okay. We'll start from here and have the Sumpter Beast, with the components on-board, lead the way.

130001004.text: This Sumpter Beast isn't familiar with us yet, so be calm and take your time with it.

subQuests.subQuestName: Observe your surroundings for anything unusual

130001204.text: Waaah! Is that the mechanical crab the caravan was talking about? It's charging straight at us!

subQuests.subQuestName: Try to communicate with the Mechanical Crab

130001402.text: Hmph, just try to escape this time, you naughty, caravan-robbing crab!

130001404.text: Hey, playing dumb won't save you! Spill it! Why are you stealing so many mechanical parts?

130001405.text: It doesn't seem to understand us...

130001406.text: Hmm, it doesn't seem capable of comprehending complex questions. Keep an eye on it. I'll search around the area for the caravans' goods.

130001407.text: After some searching, Tighnari finds the goods that the mechanical crab stole...

130001408.text: I don't know why you're stealing mechanical parts, but they don't belong to you.

130001409.text: Stolen items must be returned to their rightful owners. Any objections?

130001412.text: You came from the depths of the contaminated region, right? How about you help us with something?

130001413.text: If you take us there, I'll give you some mechanical parts as a reward.

130001417.text: We can't be certain yet. Its excitement may be a simple, programmed response upon seeing mechanical components.

130001418.text: Okay, so you want the crab to lead us into the contaminated region?

130001419.text: That's right. The contaminated region has a large and currently expanding perimeter, so it would be difficult to conduct a thorough search.

130001420.text: If we charge straight in, we'll get lost like headless pigeons. Also, our new friend here seems to be full of secrets.

130001421.text: I've been studying this contaminated region recently, and I have a hypothesis of my own. So to be absolutely safe, it would be best to have a "guide" lead the way.

130001422.text: Paimon gets it now! Does this scuttler understand what you're saying?

130001423.text: It doesn't have to, as long as it isn't hostile towards us.

130001424.text: I gave it some components that it will definitely take back to the contaminated region. So long as it doesn't attack us, we can simply follow along.

130001426.text: It seems to be really happy...

130001427.text: Listen to me. Wait for us here. No running off.

130001428.text: We'll be back soon. If you're still here when we return, I'll give you another mechanical part as a reward. Understood?

130001430.text: Does that count as understanding us?

130001431.text: I'm not sure, but our priorities are to retrieve the mechanical components, and to purchase Vasanti Grass to make medicine with.

130001432.text: We should return, but before we do, we need to set up a few "traps." Can't have that crab escaping.

subQuests.subQuestName: Give the mechanical components back to the merchant

130001502.text: These are the mechanical parts that were stolen! You really got them back for us!

130001503.text: Thank you all so very much! I don't know how I can repay you... Wait, didn't you want to purchase Vasanti Grass?

130001504.text: Don't worry about the price — they're on the house! How many do you need?

130001506.text: No, that won't do. Here, I'll throw in some Mora—

130001507.text: No need. I've already received a reward from you.

130001508.text: Reward...? You mean that bag of mechanical parts? Ah, they aren't worth much compared to this merchandise.

130001509.text: But those parts are very useful to me, just like the Vasanti Grass.

130001510.text: I retrieved the things you needed, and you gave me what I needed in return. We're even.

130001511.text: Oh, and before we go, just a reminder, the forest has an intricate and biodiverse ecosystem. Even if there were no mechanical crabs, other dangers are still present. Take caution on this route.

130001512.text: Noted! Thank you all ever so much!

130001513.text: Let's return to the village. The earlier we can give the child medicine, the sooner he'll start feeling better.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go back to Avidya Forest to heal Yara

130001602.text: Master, I prepared the pharmaceutical equipment. Do you need me to help grind the medicine?

130001603.text: No need. A precise dosage is required this time, so I'll do it myself.

130001605.text: But once I'm done, you can deliver the medication to the child.

130001606.text: He gets a little nervous when I'm around for too long. I don't think he finds me very approachable.

130001607.text: #I'll go prepare the medication. {NICKNAME}, give me a hand.

130001608.text: After you and Tighnari prepare the medicine, Collei gives it to Yara.

130001609.text: How is he? Doing any better?

130001610.text: I feel like he's doing a lot better, and his temperature is returning to normal.

130001612.text: Oh yeah, he asked me to tell you that Suna came by earlier, and he told her everything about the toy.

130001613.text: Suna didn't get mad, so he wanted to thank you. Can I ask what happened?

130001614.text: It's nothing. Did you prepare the traveling gear that I asked you to?

130001615.text: Of course I did! Are you going somewhere far away?

130001616.text: Yes, we're going to the contaminated region. Judging by its size, we will likely have to stay overnight.

130001617.text: I'm leaving everything to you while I'm gone.

130001618.text: Huh? But I... I can't even begin to compare to you...

130001619.text: Many things are learned by doing, and once they've been done, you'll realize that they weren't as difficult as you once thought they were.

130001620.text: Deal with problems as you yourself see fit. You don't have to emulate me.

130001621.text: That's right! You'll do great, Collei!

130001622.text: Alright, then I'll do my best!

130001625.text: I'm sure we'll be fine. I think you'll understand why once we arrive at the contaminated region.

130001628.text: Let's return and find that crab.

130001627.text: You put too much confidence in me. Anyway, like you said, things will likely be uneventful.

130001801.text: How's it going? Figured out a solution?

130001901.text: *sigh* Trading sure is dangerous. Not only do you have to contend with the wits of others, but you have to be ready to deal with anything and everything...

130002001.text: We can't let it get away...

130002201.text: You know, I always thought it looked kinda familiar...

130002301.text: Thank you all for your help. If it weren't for you, we would've lost a fortune.

130002401.text: In the end, the goods got stolen because you all didn't guard them properly.

130002402.text: You're not wrong, but it's not entirely our fault. No one said we'd have to go up against a mechanical crab...

130002403.text: You guys are in charge of caravan affairs, yet you didn't scout the trade route beforehand... Hey, you, here to help us settle this?

130002404.text: Umm... I'm still more interested in the whereabouts of that mechanical crab...

130002501.text: (The mechanical crab looks quite well-behaved and does not intend to run away.)

130009901.text: The Sumpter Beast went ahead. Let's keep up with it!

130009903.text: Hmm... Looks like it's loafing around. Or maybe it's hungry.

130009904.text: The caravaners grew disheartened after their goods were stolen, so they probably didn't feed their animals as scheduled. Let's give it something to eat.
